issues.claim: The company reports on-device inference hardware and a custom Yocto Linux environment. Its processor-variant plan seeks anomaly detection without affecting forwarding latency; testing must establish compatibility and forwarding impact on currently available hardware, without assuming that planned processor is available.

sources.quote: we have the hardware to run inference on-device
with a dedicated security processor to support on-device anomaly detection without affecting packet forwarding latency.

issues.explanation: Jev rates the support of this claim by its quoted evidence at 0.24; restate it to match the quote or remove it.
